description: Takes one card out of the freezer, back to What needs you, as Take it out does there. It comes back saying its age first: how old the thread is, how long ago the trend stopped being current, the day the post was for (a post comes back without its day: its yes sends it at the next free time). A post whose own words are about a moment that has passed (a premiere, a sale's last day) never comes back as it was: it ends, and Marsell writes a new version that comes to the owner as a new post (only when the person asking may make new work; otherwise it only ends); `said` says which. It never goes back in by itself. Taking a card out is free; that new version is written on the owner's tokens, at what writing a post costs.

card_id.description: the frozen card's id, from freezer_read

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
